data_section_full_text:
Sample firms and descriptive statistics
Data were collected for firms included in the Report on Business 1000 Canadian
firms for fiscal year 1994. The Report on Business 1000 Canadian firms represents
a listing of the 1,000 most profitable firms with either publicly traded debt or
equity in Canada. Financial-statement-related information was hand-collected from
the 1994 fiscal year-end annual reports to shareholders. Information concerning
board and audit committee composition and management ownership in the firm
was hand-collected from the 1994 proxy statements filed with the Ontario Securities
Commission.

Out of the top 1,000 firms, we were able to obtain a complete panel of relevant
financial statement and board and audit committee information for 627 Canadian
firms. Common causes for missing data were proxy statement unavailable (109

35 firms were excluded for a variety of miscellaneous data limitations.
